qa_pairs.instruction: Where are the Delimited Text driver shim files updated when upgrading if the driver runs on the Identity Manager server?
qa_pairs.output: For the Delimited Text driver running on the Identity Manager server, the driver shim files are updated automatically when you update the server, unless they were not selected during a custom installation.

qa_pairs.instruction: How are the Delimited Text driver shim files updated if the driver is running on a server other than the Identity Manager server?
qa_pairs.output: When the Delimited Text driver is running on a server other than the Identity Manager server, the driver shim files are updated when you update the Remote Loader on that server.

qa_pairs.instruction: Which driver configuration file versions does the Delimited Text driver shim version 4.0.0.3 support?
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver shim version 4.0.0.3 supports drivers created using any 3.x version of the driver configuration file. You can continue to use these driver configurations until you want to upgrade the driver to packages.

qa_pairs.instruction: Can I continue using older 3.x driver configurations with the Delimited Text driver shim version 4.0.0.3?
qa_pairs.output: Yes, with the Delimited Text driver shim version 4.0.0.3, you can continue to use driver configurations created by any 3.x version until you decide to upgrade the driver to packages.

qa_pairs.instruction: What are the key considerations when upgrading an existing Delimited Text driver to version 4.0?
qa_pairs.output: When upgrading an existing Delimited Text driver to version 4.0, key considerations include: (1) Driver shim files are automatically updated when you update the Identity Manager server or Remote Loader (depending on where the driver runs), unless files were deselected during custom installation. (2) The 4.0.0.3 driver shim is backward compatible with any 3.x driver configuration files, allowing you to continue using existing configurations until you choose to upgrade to packages. (3) The upgrade process involves understanding supported upgrade paths, reviewing what's new in version 4.0.2, and following the documented upgrade procedure.
